extensionDescription.message: Translate subtitles ahead and watch in sync. Tested with MUBI.

diagnosticHint.message: Diagnostics stay on this PC and exclude dialogue text.

startHint.message: Turn on the original subtitles. Initial preparation takes a moment; translation continues while paused.

consent.message: I agree to send subtitle text and context to my selected translation provider.

consentNeeded.message: Please accept the subtitle processing notice first.

window.message: Prepares the needed cues up to 5 minutes ahead.

domHint.message: No full timeline found. Visible subtitles are translated after they appear.

domDelay.message: This fallback can lag by the model response time.

clickStart.message: Choose “Start on this site” to begin.

started.message: Started. Enable original subtitles; reload the page if needed.

startFailed.message: Could not start. Check the video page and site permission.

stopped.message: Subtitle translation is disabled on this site.

stopFailed.message: Could not change the site settings.

diagFailed.message: Could not save diagnostics. Check site permissions and the connection.

usageEmpty.message: Token usage will be measured from your next translation.

usage.message: {calls} successful requests · Input {input} (cached {cached}) · Output {output} tokens · Last batch {batch} cues / {duration}s

measured.message: Measured successful requests only. Excludes failed or interrupted requests.

providerHint.message: ChatGPT OAuth runs in the browser without a helper (experimental). Codex CLI and Ollama are optional advanced providers.

sourceAuto.message: The source language is detected from the subtitles.

original.message: Show original text when the player is not displaying it

helperOk.message: Helper {version} is available. Account/model access is checked on the first translation.

helperMissing.message: The helper is running, but the selected provider is unavailable.

cacheCleared.message: Saved translations cleared. Reload the video page to clear its memory cache.

helperHint.message: ChatGPT browser mode uses official sign-in without a local helper. Codex CLI and Ollama modes require the helper. Provider limits or charges may apply.

pickHint.message: Click the original subtitle text. Press Esc to cancel.

pickInvalid.message: No subtitle text found there. Click directly on the dialogue.

pickFailed.message: Could not save the subtitle area.

pickSaved.message: Subtitle area selected. Source language is detected automatically.

noTimeline.message: No timeline yet · Waiting for visible subtitles

lagMode.message: No timeline · Translating after subtitles appear

bridgeGeneric.message: Could not connect to the helper.

bridgeMissing.message: The helper is not registered in this browser, or its path is invalid.

bridgeForbidden.message: The extension ID does not match the helper allowlist.

bridgeLaunch.message: Could not launch the registered helper. Check its installation path.

bridgeExited.message: The helper exited before replying or communication failed.

scopeNote.message: Independent subtitle translator · Tested with MUBI

oauthIntro.message: Use your ChatGPT plan without Python, Codex CLI, or a local helper.

oauthMemory.message: Keep this tab open while watching. Credentials stay only in this tab’s memory. Closing it clears the local session; use Sign out to revoke access.

planHint.message: Eligible requests use your ChatGPT plan or credits. Manage this app’s allowance in ChatGPT settings.

connectionReady.message: Connected. Keep this tab open, enable subtitles in MUBI, and start translation.

connectionSignedIn.message: Signed in. Choose a model and confirm use of your ChatGPT plan.

connectionPrompt.message: Complete official sign-in and plan permission in the sign-in window.

connectionClosed.message: Sign-in window closed. You can try again.

loggedOut.message: Signed out. Renewable access was revoked.

localLogout.message: Signed out locally. Remote revocation was not confirmed; disconnect the app in ChatGPT settings if needed.

oauthStart.message: Choose Continue with ChatGPT to connect.
